en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a small wooden railway station with a gabled roof and decorative veranda. Railway tracks run in the foreground, several people in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century clothing stand on the platform, and a horse cart is visible near the station building. There are signboards on the façade, but the text is not legible. A small serial number appears at the lower left corner of the image.
